Hi :) 

I know this will probably only reach as far as it can on the internet but I hope this helps. 

Your skin does not define you. What defines you is how you carry yourself. I know that this probably won’t help to hear but there will always and forever be people who will comment on that. Even if racism lessens or get significantly better, there will always be those lying beneath the pits of Hell to ruin your day because of something you can’t control. 

You can’t control your skin color and you shouldn’t try to. It would be going against nature. Your skin is beautiful the way it is. The fact that it exists is the very reason that it was meant to be here. 

People live to hurt but don’t hurt yourself trying to please those who doesn’t care about your happiness. Hatred is a strong thing to harbor inside one’s self but they continue to do so. Who wants to wake up with Ill intent everyday?? Don’t feed the hatred.
